tweets.text: Massage gun or red light panel — which one deserves your money first? Depends on one question: do you want instant relief after a hard workout, or are you trying to fix stiffness that's stuck around for weeks? The answer isn't the same for everyone. #recoverytools #massagegun #redlighttherapy

Massage gun vs red light panel, quick breakdown:
Price: $60-400 vs $150-1000+
Session time: 1-5 min vs 10-20 min
Best for: acute post-workout tightness vs chronic stiffness
Portability: massage gun wins
Habit-building: red light panel wins
Under $200 budget? Massage gun is the practical pick. #recoveryroutine #homewellness #musclerecovery

Before: skipping recovery because you don't know which tool to trust. After: knowing exactly which one fits your soreness (acute vs chronic), your budget, and your actual routine -- not just what's trending. That clarity alone changes whether you'll stick with it. #recoverytools #wellnesshabits #homerecovery
